name: Motel Mexicola Canggu
description: is a vibrant Mexican restaurant, bar, and party venue located near Batu Bolong beach in Canggu, Bali. It features a colorful and detailed interior design inspired by different eras of Mexican history, offers a menu of tacos and other Mexican dishes, and hosts events like themed parties and DJ nights that turn into a high-energy dance spot later in the evening.
